RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

Monthly rent is $1,450 due on the first of each month. Security deposit: $1,450. Late fee of $75 applies after a 3-day grace period. Tenant shall maintain the premises in good condition. Landlord may enter with reasonable notice of at least 24 hours.
